name: Swiss International Air Lines
tagline: Switzerland's flag carrier, started in 2002 from the remains of Swissair and now part of the Lufthansa Group.
bio: Swiss International Air Lines began flying on 31 March 2002, after the bankruptcy of Swissair. It was built around Crossair, Swissair's regional subsidiary, which was renamed Swiss.

Lufthansa announced its plan to take over Swiss on 22 March 2005 and completed the purchase on 1 July 2007. Swiss joined Star Alliance on 1 April 2006. It flies from Zurich and Geneva with Airbus A220, A320 family, A330 and A350 aircraft and Boeing 777-300ERs.
